title: when-eval: code for “Evaluating repeated clinical forecasts from longitudinal data: between-patient bias, finite-record bias, and how to correct them”
description: The wheneval Python package and its R port, the simulations, the cohort analyses, and the scripts that produce every table and figure of the paper “Evaluating repeated clinical forecasts from longitudinal data: between-patient bias, finite-record bias, and how to correct them”.

creators.name: Remy, Wesley
creators.affiliation: Department of Computer Science, ETH Zurich, Zurich, Switzerland
